technical-summary: Lab modes that measure full-DiT residency on one XTX and run four LTX guidance passes across the R9700 and both XTX cards: same-card outputs are bit-identical, cross-card outputs are reported as relative RMS (about 1.5-2%), speedup over one R9700 is 1.75x at 768x512 and 1.58x at 1216x704; evidence added.
user-summary-candidate: Measured that the full LTX DiT fits one XTX at typical resolutions and that placing guidance passes across the three cards is 1.6-1.75x faster than the R9700 alone.
